fillToTheLine.en: Filled to the line. On yours or ours.
fillToTheLine.fr: Rempli jusqu’à la ligne. Sur la vôtre ou la nôtre.
fillToTheLine.reading: Fill line (fill-to-line, the floor's own term) and production line. 'Yours' is Second Shift at your plant; 'ours' is Bottleneck at our facility. Works identically in French: 'ligne' is both.

bottleneckTrade.en: Got a bottleneck? Filling them is the job.
bottleneckTrade.fr: Un goulot? Le remplir, c’est notre métier.
bottleneckTrade.reading: Bottleneck/goulot as the neck of a bottle (we fill them) and as the constraint in your plant (we take it off your hands).

shiftEnds.en: Your line keeps running when your shift ends.
shiftEnds.fr: Votre ligne roule encore quand votre quart finit.
shiftEnds.reading: The Second Shift angle: the output continues after your own shift, run by VKC.
